sayings.quote: Whoever puts their feet on Shirdi soil, their sufferings will come to an end.
sayings.context: Chapter 1 & Epilogue - Sai Baba’s 1st Assurance
sayings.meaning: Turning your heart and mind toward Shirdi dissolves worries and initiates inner healing.

sayings.quote: The wretched and miserable will rise to joy and happiness as soon as they climb the steps of the Samadhi Mandir.
sayings.context: Chapter 1 - Sai Baba’s 2nd Assurance
sayings.meaning: No matter how deep your sorrow, approaching Baba brings instant comfort and elevation.

sayings.quote: I shall be ever active and vigorous even after leaving this earthly body.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 3rd Assurance
sayings.meaning: Baba’s guidance is not bound by time or physical form; His spirit is alive right here and now.

sayings.quote: My tomb shall bless and speak to the needs of my devotees.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 4th Assurance
sayings.meaning: Whenever you whisper a prayer to Baba, the Samadhi Mandir resonates with His answer.

sayings.quote: I shall be active and vigorous even from the tomb.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 5th Assurance
sayings.meaning: Baba’s protective shield remains eternally vigilant over every home that remembers Him.

sayings.quote: My mortal remains will speak from my tomb.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 6th Assurance
sayings.meaning: Even in silence, the presence of Baba brings certainty and faith to confused minds.

sayings.quote: I am ever living to help and guide all who come to me, who surrender to me and who seek refuge in me.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 7th Assurance
sayings.meaning: True surrender (Sharanagati) guarantees Baba’s personal guardianship through every storm.

sayings.quote: If you look to me, I look to you.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 8th Assurance
sayings.meaning: The moment you fix your gaze and thoughts on Baba, His compassionate glance envelops you.

sayings.quote: If you cast your burden on me, I shall surely bear it.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 9th Assurance
sayings.meaning: Do not exhaust yourself carrying anxiety; place all your worries at Baba’s lotus feet.

sayings.quote: If you seek my advice and help, it shall be given to you at once.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 10th Assurance
sayings.meaning: Whenever you sit in quiet prayer and ask Baba, divine intuition will illuminate the right path.

sayings.quote: There shall be no want in the house of my devotee.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Sai Baba’s 11th Assurance
sayings.meaning: Baba provides both material sustenance and spiritual abundance to those who love Him.

sayings.quote: Give me two coins: Shraddha (firm, unwavering faith) and Saburi (patient, joyful perseverance). With these two, you cross the ocean of worldly troubles safely.
sayings.context: Chapter 18 & 19 - Baba asking Radha-Bai Deshmukh for Dakshina
sayings.meaning: Spiritual and worldly success requires unwavering trust in God paired with peaceful patience.

sayings.quote: Do not rush the fruit before it is ripe. Have patience and wait; the harvest of devotion is always exceedingly sweet.
sayings.context: Chapter 19 - On spiritual progress and timing
sayings.meaning: Patience is not passive waiting; it is the joyful confidence that God is arranging things for the best.

sayings.quote: My man, even if he be a thousand miles away, I shall draw him to Me as a sparrow tied with a string to its foot.
sayings.context: Chapter 28 - On how devotees are guided to Shirdi
sayings.meaning: No devotee is ever forgotten or out of reach. Baba’s invisible cord of love pulls you home.

sayings.quote: Trust in the Guru fully. That alone is the true Sadhana. Let there be no doubts or hesitations in your devotion.
sayings.context: Chapter 2 - On the necessity of a Sadguru
sayings.meaning: Complicated rituals cannot match the simple, profound power of steady faith in your Guru.

sayings.quote: If a man utters My name with love, I shall fulfill all his noble wishes and continuously increase his devotion.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Promise to Hemadpant
sayings.meaning: Simple remembrance of "Sai" cleanses the mind and opens the doorway to divine grace.

sayings.quote: Do not fast or starve your body. An empty stomach cannot meditate. Give food to the body, and it will serve you in your prayers.
sayings.context: Chapter 32 - Mrs. Gokhale’s Fasting Episode
sayings.meaning: Avoid extreme mortifications; maintain balanced physical well-being to nurture spiritual growth.

sayings.quote: Hold fast to the handle of knowledge and devotion of the hand-mill; turn inward to the center, and you are saved from being crushed.
sayings.context: Chapter 1 - The Kabir Metaphor in the Grinding of Wheat
sayings.meaning: Anchor your mind on God at the center of life, and worldly upheavals will not shatter your peace.

sayings.quote: What you sow, you must reap. Sow seeds of faith, truthfulness, and kindness, and your days will be blessed.
sayings.context: Chapter 47 - Baba’s teachings on moral conduct
sayings.meaning: Right actions and benevolent thoughts inevitably bring divine peace back into your life.

sayings.quote: Why fear when I am here? Bow to the feet of the Guru with full surrender, and let go of anxiety.
sayings.context: Chapter 13 - Baba reassuring devotees in times of crisis
sayings.meaning: Fear vanishes the moment you realize Baba is standing beside you in every challenge.

sayings.quote: Be wherever you like, do whatever you choose, but remember this well: all you do is known to Me. I am the Inner Ruler seated in your heart.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - Baba’s nectar-like words after noon Aarti
sayings.meaning: You are never alone or unobserved; Baba dwells as the compassionate inner witness of your life.

sayings.quote: I will not allow my devotee to fall. If he is about to slip, I stretch out my hands and hold him fast.
sayings.context: Chapter 28 - Baba shielding Kakasaheb Dixit
sayings.meaning: When you stumble or lose confidence, Baba catches you before you hit the ground.

sayings.quote: Cast all your cares upon Me, and I shall look after all your affairs. He who clings to Me will never be forsaken.
sayings.context: Chapter 15 - Cholkar’s Sugar Offering
sayings.meaning: Hand over the driver’s seat of your life to Baba, and trust His steering.

sayings.quote: My eyes are ever watchful over those who love Me. I protect them as a mother bird covers her fledglings under her wings.
sayings.context: Chapter 43 - On Baba’s motherly solicitude
sayings.meaning: Under Baba’s wings, no misfortune can overpower you.

sayings.quote: Even if the heavens fall, I will protect you. Put all your trust in Me and walk forward without trembling.
sayings.context: Chapter 22 - The Storm and Lightning at Dwarkamai
sayings.meaning: Circumstances may appear overwhelming, but Baba’s grace is mightier than any crisis.

sayings.quote: I am the slave of those who love Me. I run to their side the instant they call with a pure, longing heart.
sayings.context: Chapter 12 - Meeting with Dr. Pandit and devotees
sayings.meaning: God is conquered not by intellectual prowess or wealth, but by pure, childlike love.

sayings.quote: I give my devotees what they desire, so that they may learn to desire what I truly want to give them: liberation.
sayings.context: Chapter 13 - Baba on granting worldly boons
sayings.meaning: Baba fulfills our worldly requests first, to awaken in us the higher thirst for lasting peace.

sayings.quote: I am in every creature—in the dog, the cat, the bird, the cow, and the fly. The one who feeds a hungry creature feeds Me.
sayings.context: Chapter 9 - Mrs. Tarkhad feeding a dog in Bandra
sayings.meaning: Kindness shown to any helpless animal or human is directly received and cherished by Baba.

sayings.quote: Do not bark at anyone. Do not lose your temper or retaliate with harsh words. If someone insults you, bear it with patience; God will reward your silence.
sayings.context: Chapter 19 - Baba advising devotees against quarrels
sayings.meaning: Silence and humility in the face of provocation conserve spiritual energy and invite grace.

sayings.quote: If someone comes to your door hungry or in need, never turn them away empty-handed. Give what you can with reverence.
sayings.context: Chapter 42 - The virtues of Annadaan (feeding others)
sayings.meaning: Sharing your food and resources with the needy is the highest form of worship.

sayings.quote: If you want peace of mind, do not look at the faults of others. Look at your own shortcomings and correct them with love.
sayings.context: Chapter 21 - Overcoming fault-finding and gossip
sayings.meaning: Criticism of others blinds us to our own flaws; true peace begins with self-purification.

sayings.quote: Never hurt anyone with words. A wound from a sword heals in time, but a wound from a cruel tongue festers forever.
sayings.context: Chapter 44 - On sweet, gentle speech
sayings.meaning: Speak gently and truthfully. Let your words bring comfort rather than pain.

sayings.quote: See Rama in Rahim, see Krishna in Christ. All paths that lead to love and righteousness lead to the same Supreme Father.
sayings.context: Chapter 7 - Dwarkamai as the sanctuary of all faiths
sayings.meaning: True spirituality embraces all genuine paths; God has no religion other than pure love.

sayings.quote: Do not hate or despise anyone. We are all passengers on the same journey, driven by the same Divine Will.
sayings.context: Chapter 10 - On broad-mindedness and brotherhood
sayings.meaning: Recognize that every soul is evolving at their own pace; treat all with equal dignity.

sayings.quote: He who shares his bread with the poor, the orphaned, and the destitute is the dearest to My heart.
sayings.context: Chapter 38 - Baba cooking in the Handi for all villagers
sayings.meaning: Selfless charity without pride is the fastest way to dissolve worldly attachments.

sayings.quote: Nobody comes to us without past account (Rin-anubandha). Therefore, welcome whoever crosses your path without annoyance or contempt.
sayings.context: Chapter 47 - Veerabhadrappa and Chenbassappa story
sayings.meaning: Every relationship and encounter is a karmic debt being settled. Treat everyone with grace.

sayings.quote: Greed and spiritual enlightenment can never live together. Cast off greed, and the Lord will reveal Himself in your heart.
sayings.context: Chapter 16 & 17 - The rich gentleman seeking Brahma-Jnana
sayings.meaning: Attachment to hoarding wealth or praise blocks the inward flow of spiritual realization.

sayings.quote: Contentment is the greatest treasure. Be satisfied with what Providence has granted, and you will never feel impoverished.
sayings.context: Chapter 35 - On simplicity and contentment
sayings.meaning: A contented heart lives in a palace of peace, regardless of outward circumstances.

sayings.quote: What God gives, no one can snatch away; what God withholds, no one can bestow. Rest your mind in His decree.
sayings.context: Chapter 29 - Story of the Madras Bhajan Mela
sayings.meaning: Accept the divine will with peaceful serenity; God knows what is best for your soul.

sayings.quote: Do not borrow beyond your means, and do not covet another’s belongings. Walk the path of honest labor and clear conscience.
sayings.context: Chapter 41 - Teachings on debt and integrity
sayings.meaning: Living simply within your means keeps your mind unburdened and spirit free.

sayings.quote: The wheel of Karma turns relentlessly. By patient endurance and remembering God, old debts are wiped clean forever.
sayings.context: Chapter 34 - Dr. Pillay’s Guinea-Worm cure
sayings.meaning: Enduring trials with patience and devotion burns away past negative karma.

sayings.quote: Do not boast of your intellect, pedigree, or wealth. Egoism is the sole curtain hanging between you and the Divine.
sayings.context: Chapter 2 - Dabholkar receiving the title Hemadpant
sayings.meaning: True humility dissolves the ego and allows the light of God to shine through you.

sayings.quote: Allah Maalik! God is the Supreme Master. He is the doer, He is the ruler. Dedicate every breath to Him.
sayings.context: Every Chapter - Sai Baba’s signature sacred declaration
sayings.meaning: Remember that the Supreme Lord is the sovereign master of all events in the universe.

sayings.quote: Whenever you think of Me or sit in prayer, know that I am present right with you, listening to your silent call.
sayings.context: Chapter 40 - Baba appearing in dreams and visions
sayings.meaning: Distance is an illusion of the body; in spirit, Baba is as close to you as your very breath.

sayings.quote: The simple remembrance of the name "Sai" with love washes away sins of speech, action, and thought.
sayings.context: Chapter 3 - The power of Sai Nama-Smaran
sayings.meaning: Chanting Baba’s name fills the subconscious mind with purity, calmness, and joy.

sayings.quote: Let your senses perform their duties in the world, but let your inner mind stay anchored at the holy feet of the Lord.
sayings.context: Chapter 27 - Bhagwat Gita discourse with Nana Chandorkar
sayings.meaning: Live actively in the world without being of the world; maintain inner detachment.

sayings.quote: Keep your heart clean and your intentions pure. When the vessel is spotless, the Guru’s grace fills it to overflowing.
sayings.context: Chapter 45 - Kakasaheb Dixit and the purity of devotion
sayings.meaning: Sincerity and clean intentions attract divine blessings effortlessly.

sayings.quote: My tomb shall not be a place of silence; it shall speak with hope, solace, and courage to generations yet unborn.
sayings.context: Chapter 42 - Passing into Mahasamadhi
sayings.meaning: Baba’s Samadhi is an eternal powerhouse of hope, healing, and spiritual rejuvenation.

sayings.quote: Remember Me in times of prosperity as faithfully as you remember Me in times of hardship, and misery will never cross your threshold.
sayings.context: Chapter 24 - On continuous and steadfast devotion
sayings.meaning: True devotion expresses daily gratitude in joyful times, not merely when seeking help in distress.

sayings.quote: I need no rituals, no complex offerings, and no proud intellect. Give Me your simple love, and I am yours forever.
sayings.context: Chapter 14 - Ruttonji Wadia and Baba’s acceptance of love
sayings.meaning: The simplest prayer spoken from a sincere heart reaches Baba instantly.

sayings.quote: If you cannot meditate on the formless Absolute, meditate on My form with love. Seeing My form will easily lead you to the formless Reality.
sayings.context: Chapter 26 - Teachings on Saguna Bhakti (worship of the Form)
sayings.meaning: Focusing on Baba’s loving form calms the wandering mind and makes meditation natural and sweet.

sayings.quote: Peace is the highest ornament of a seeker. Protect your inner peace as a miser protects his gold.
sayings.context: Chapter 4 - Sai Baba’s personality and equanimity
sayings.meaning: Do not allow trivial worldly disputes to rob you of your priceless inner tranquillity.

aartis.name: Kakad Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Morning Awakening Prayer
aartis.meaning: Devotees gather before sunrise to gently wake Baba with sweet, loving hymns and prayers for spiritual awakening.
verses: Joduniyaa kara charanee thevila maatha | Parisawe vinantee maazhee Sadguru naatha ||
Aso nasso bhaava aalo tujhiyaa thhaayaa | Kripaa drishtee paahay maazhyaa Sadguru raayaa ||
Uthaa Panduranga aataa prabhaat samayo paatalaa | Vaishnavaancha mela garudapaaree daatalaa ||
Uthaa uthaa Shree Saainaathha Guru charana kamala daavaa | Aadhivyaadhi bhawataapa vaaruni taaraa jada jeeva ||

aartis.name: Madhyan Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Afternoon Offering
aartis.meaning: Midday prayer and offering of Naivedya (food) honoring Sai Baba as the supreme divine host.
verses: Gheuniyaa panchaarati karoo Babansi aarati | Karoo Saayeesi aarati ||
Uthha uthha baa Saayeerama aataa aalelya paahunaa | Bhakteechiya premabhaave baadhilee shidori ||
Aarati Saayee Baba, saukhyadaataara jeeva | Charana rajataalee, dhyawaa daasaam visaawaa ||

aartis.name: Dhoop Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Evening Twilight Prayer
aartis.meaning: At sunset, as lamps are lit at the Dhuni and Dwarkamai, devotees sing praises thanking Baba for His shelter through the day.
verses: Aarati Saayee Baba, saukhyadaataara jeeva | Charana rajataalee, dhyawaa daasaam visaawaa ||
Jaya deva jaya deva Datta avadhootaa | Owaaloo aarati Maazhyaa Sadguru Saayeeshaa ||
Kaarunyasindhu Baba dinaancha daataa | Maazhi he vinantee aayikee Eeshwara raayaa ||

aartis.name: Shej Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Night Rest Prayer
aartis.meaning: The final aarti of the day, a soothing lullaby bidding Sai Baba peaceful rest and seeking His protection through the night.
verses: Owaaloo aarati maazhyaa Sadguru raayaa | Shreemanta Saayeenaathha charana kamalaa ||
Aataa suvaamee sukhe nidra karaa avadhootaa | Chinmaya he roopa maazhe daakhawaa netraam ||
Paava ga Saayeeraayaa bhava sagara taaree | Kripaakatakshe maazhyaa hridayaantee raahoo ||
